UPI transactions are recorded by banks and reflected in bank statements but in case of Digital Rupee, no data is captured in bank statements as transactions are from one wallet to another
In both the cases (UPI and Digital Rupee), the liability lies with the users and their respective banks

Under this scheme beneficiaries are given RuPay debit card with other banking services, in which accident insurance cover of Rs. 1 lakh (enhanced to Rs. 2 lakh to new PMJDY accounts opened after 28.8.2018) is included. During the launch, Prime Minister also announced a life insurance cover of Rs. 30,000 for those subscribing to a bank account with a RuPay debit card before 26th January, 2015.
